title: Purpose clue: conciliatory
instructions: Choose the meaning that best fits the sentence.

parts.prompt: After the disagreement, Lina used a conciliatory tone and suggested a solution that respected both groups. What does “conciliatory” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: Respecting both groups after a disagreement is intended to restore peace.
choice_rationales.B: The proposed solution clarifies a way forward.
choice_rationales.C: The context concerns resolving conflict, not excitement.
choice_rationales.D: Respecting both groups signals willingness to compromise.

parts.hint: Ask what Lina hopes her tone and proposal will achieve.
parts.correct_explanation: Her approach aims to reduce conflict and restore cooperation, so conciliatory means intended to restore peace.
